title: Nvidia boss ends – level 2
paragraphs: Nvidia’s share price dropped quickly after its CEO and co-founder, Jensen Huang, suddenly resigned.
He left the company after facing serious investigations over a personal affair with a woman who was a suspected Chinese spy, as well as a second affair with a company manager.

To keep business running smoothly, Nvidia named its finance boss as temporary leader. Experts say replacing Huang will be very difficult because he led the company for 33 years and was very important to its success in AI.

US officials plan to investigate what the company knew about the spying and whether Nvidia broke rules by selling computer chips to China. This problem could lead to stricter US trade laws and increased tension between America and China.
